summary.text: Father of Midas, to whom tradition ascribed the founding of Phrygian cities beyond the Sangarius, including Ancyra.

story.text: Pausanias, telling how the Gauls crossed the Sangarius and captured Ancyra, records that Midas son of Gordius had founded that Phrygian city in former times — the only explicit genealogical anchor for Gordius in our sources.
